subject: Novanova POC — proposed success criteria, compressed timeline & kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Torres <ellie@novanova.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Novanova POC — proposed success criteria, compressed timeline & kickoff

Hi Ellie — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I loop in resources:

Summary of call:
- Primary use case: in-product search ranking and contextual assist for customer support tickets (English only to start).
- Key constraints: soft latency targets (<= 250ms p50 on 512-token queries), must run in Novanova's VPC for data controls, and procurement needs SOC2 evidence ahead of contract.

Proposed POC objective (3-week focused trial):
1) Success criteria (pass/fail gates):
   - Relevance: uplift of 15%+ in top-3 MAP on the sample query set vs baseline (you provided).
   - Latency: p50 <= 250ms, p90 <= 400ms on test harness for 512-token median workload.
   - Stability: no more than 2 intervention events (restarts/failover) during the trial window.
   - Security: integration with your VPC + KMS key for inference is validated and documented.

2) High-level timeline (compressed option you asked about):
   - Week 0 (this week): kickoff and environment access, provide SOC2 summary and infra checklist.
   - Week 1: model onboarding + initial runs; weekly sync #1 at end of week.
   - Week 2: iteration on prompts/quantization profile; workload soak; weekly sync #2.
   - Week 3: final readout, pass/fail decision and next-step commercial discussion.

3) Owners / contacts:
   - Sales + program lead: Jonas Weber (me) — overall timeline and procurement coordination.
   - Solutions / technical lead: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> — will own model onboarding and performance tuning.
   - Account manager / rollout ops: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> — will own scheduling and billing questions.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short POC playbook and a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone owners.

Immediate asks for Novanova: please confirm
- a) Whether the compressed 3-week cadence is feasible,
- b) Tech contact for infra/VPC access (name + email), and
- c) Any hard dates procurement needs for SOC2 artifacts.

If that looks good I’ll send calendar invites for kickoff (aiming for next Tue 10am PT) and loop Marissa into the thread.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Novanova_POC_Playbook_v1.pdf, Novanova_mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Ellie Torres <ellie@novanova.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novanova POC — proposed success criteria, compressed timeline & kickoff

Jonas — thanks for the thorough recap. A few notes from our side: 

1) Compressed timeline looks attractive — procurement wants SOC2 evidence before we sign anything; we don’t need the full report but a scope summary and a pointer to your auditor will do. Can you share that by end of day tomorrow?

2) Tech contact: Samir Patel (samir.patel@novanova.com) will be our infra lead; he’ll coordinate VPC peering and KMS setup.

3) Internal constraint: the product team is swamped the week after next (Mar 8-12); if kickoff is next Tue we can probably still hit the three-week window but we may need one of your engineers to lead more of the early setup.

4) Success criteria: the relevance uplift target looks reasonable, but could we add a qualitative CSAT check from our support team on 25 sample responses during week 3? That will help our PMs evaluate quality beyond MAP.

I’ll loop Samir on his availability. We’re excited to move quickly here.

—Ellie
VP, Product
Novanova
ellie@novanova.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Torres <ellie@novanova.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novanova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Novanova POC — proposed success criteria, compressed timeline & kickoff

Ellie — great, thanks for the quick notes and the intro to Samir.

Action items I’ll take now: 
- Share SOC2 scope summary and auditor contact by tomorrow EOD (see related link: SOC2 summary doc).
- Updated POC playbook attached (I compressed the roles and added the CSAT check you suggested for week 3).
- Proposed kickoff: Tue Mar 2, 10:00 AM PT (I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm Samir’s availability).

Marissa — based on Ellie’s note about product availability, can your SEs take point on the initial VPC/KMS setup so Novanova has a fast path? If possible we’ll allocate one engineer for an initial 4-6 hour stretch next Tue/Wed.

Samir — welcome. Can you share the AWS account ID and preferred VPC peering window? Also, any procurement point-of-contact from your team so we can deliver the SOC2 summary to the right inbox?

Next steps: I’ve attached an updated MAP and a compressed POC playbook. If everyone agrees I’ll post invites and we’ll treat the kickoff as the official Week 0 starting point.

Thanks —
Jonas

Attachments: Novanova_POC_Playbook_v1.1.pdf, Novanova_mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Hi team — quick note from the ops side: we’ve confirmed SE coverage for the kickoff window and blocked recurring weekly 30-minute check-ins on Wed 9:30 AM PT (weeks 1 & 2). Final readout slot: Thu Mar 18, 11:00 AM PT.

I’ve created the calendar invites here: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?eid=novanova-kickoff — Jonas will send to your full list once Samir confirms account details.

Logistics: 
- Marissa will be primary SE (first 6 hours) for initial VPC peering and test harness setup.
- I’ll own billing and contract intake; please cc me on procurement contacts and any DocuSign links.

Ellie — please confirm Samir’s availability for the kickoff and whether procurement would accept the SOC2 scope summary by tomorrow. If so, Jonas will attach the doc to the HubSpot deal.

Best —
Lauren Bishop
